seu_api.h

Single-event upset (SEU) statistics, error queue, and test injection through the Secure Device Manager.

Constants
SEU_API_ERR_TYPE_NONE

SEU error-queue severity value indicating no error.

SEU_API_ERR_TYPE_SINGLE_BIT

SEU error-queue severity value for a single-bit error.

SEU_API_ERR_TYPE_DOUBLE_BIT

SEU error-queue severity value for a double-bit error.

SEU_API_ERR_TYPE_MULTI_BIT

SEU error-queue severity value for a multi-bit error.

SEU_API_ERR_TYPE_CRAM_INTEGRITY

SEU error-queue severity value for a configuration-RAM integrity error.

SEU_API_FPGA_RAM_ERR_MODE_SBE

FPGA RAM injection mode selecting a single-bit correctable error.

SEU_API_FPGA_RAM_ERR_MODE_DBE

FPGA RAM injection mode selecting a double-bit error. Availability can depend on target-device support.

seu_api_callback_t
typedef void (
*
seu_api_callback_t
)(void)

Notification callback stored by seu_api_set_callback() for the SEU interrupt path. The callback has no arguments and is not invoked by polling-only flows.

seu_api_inj_params_t

Parameters for a safe configuration-RAM error injection.

Fields
cram_sel0

First injection location, 0 through 15.

cram_sel1

Second injection location, 0 through 15; when count is 2 it must differ from cram_sel0.

injection_cycle

Injection timing selector: 0, 1, or 2.

count

Number of errors to inject: 1 or 2.

seu_api_stat_t

SEU timing statistics returned by seu_api_read_stat(). Values are Secure Device Manager clock ticks; 0xFFFFFFFF means the corresponding event has not occurred.

Fields
t_seu_cycle

Time between consecutive detection cycles.

t_seu_detect

Time spent detecting an SEU within one cycle.

t_seu_correct

Time spent correcting the most recent SEU.

t_seu_inject_detect

Latency from injection trigger to detection.

t_poll_interval

Internal SEU polling interval.

seu_api_err_data_t

One SEU error-queue entry returned by seu_api_read_err(). The fields are meaningful when that call succeeds and err_cnt is greater than zero.

Fields
sector_addr

LSM sector index associated with the event.

err_type

Bit-error severity represented by a SEU_API_ERR_TYPE_* value.

err_cnt

Number of errors represented by the queue entry.

corrected

true when the scrubber reports the error corrected.

int seu_api_init(

)

Initialize the SEU driver and verify access to its command and response scratch buffers.

Returns

0 on success. -EIO when the scratch-buffer probe fails.

seu_api_deinit
int seu_api_deinit(
void
)

Release SEU subsystem resources.

Returns

0 on success.

seu_api_set_callback
int seu_api_set_callback(
seu_api_callback_t 
cb
)

Register a notification callback for SEU interrupt events.

The callback is stored but only invoked when the interrupt path is active.  In polling-only builds it serves as a hook for future use.

Parameters
cb
seu_api_callback_t

Callback function pointer; must not be NULL.

Returns

0 on success, -EINVAL if cb is NULL.

seu_api_get_first_valid_sector
int seu_api_get_first_valid_sector(
uint8_t 
max_probe,
uint8_t 
*
out_sector
)

Probe the SDM to find the first valid LSM sector index.

The SDM does not expose a topology-enumeration command, so this function issues successive seu_api_read_stat() probes starting at index 0 and returns the first index for which the SDM reports success.  Each probe consumes one mailbox job slot; keep max_probe modest (8 is a typical probe limit).

Parameters
max_probe
uint8_t

Maximum number of indices to probe (1..255).

out_sector
uint8_t*

Receives the discovered sector index on success.

Returns

0 on success, -EINVAL on bad arguments, -ENODEV if no valid sector was found (FPGA not in user mode or index range too small).

seu_api_read_stat
int seu_api_read_stat(
uint8_t 
sector,
seu_api_stat_t 
*
out_stat
)

Read SEU timing statistics for the given sector.

Parameters
sector
uint8_t

LSM sector index obtained from seu_api_get_first_valid_sector().

out_stat
seu_api_stat_t*

Receives the timing counters on success; must not be NULL.

Returns

0 on success, -EINVAL if out_stat is NULL, -EIO on SDM error.

seu_api_insert_safe_err
int seu_api_insert_safe_err(
uint8_t 
sector,
const 
seu_api_inj_params_t 
*
params
)

Inject a safe (non-destructive) CRAM SEU error.

Sends the injection request to the SDM.  The injected error is automatically corrected by the SDM scrubber on its next cycle and appears in the error queue read by seu_api_read_err().

Parameters
sector
uint8_t

LSM sector index to target.

params
const seu_api_inj_params_t*

Injection parameters; must not be NULL.

Returns

0 on success, -EINVAL on bad parameters, -EIO on SDM rejection.

seu_api_read_err
int seu_api_read_err(
seu_api_err_data_t 
*
out_err
)

Read one entry from the SDM SEU error queue.

On success, out_err is populated.  When the queue is empty (no error event pending) the call succeeds with out_err->err_cnt == 0.

Parameters
out_err
seu_api_err_data_t*

Receives the error data; must not be NULL.

Returns

0 on success, -EINVAL if out_err is NULL, -EIO on SDM error.

seu_api_inject_fpga_ram_err
int seu_api_inject_fpga_ram_err(
uint8_t 
sector,
uint8_t 
err_mode,
uint8_t 
ram_id
)

Inject an FPGA-fabric LSM NIOS RAM error via the SDM.

Wraps SDM mailbox cmd 0x42.  The SDM sends a CNOC IPC to the target sector, which physically flips a bit in the tile's NIOS RAM.  On the next scrub read the LSM detects (and corrects, for single-bit) the flip and notifies the SDM, which enqueues a single-bit (or multi-bit) event retrievable via seu_api_read_err().

Parameters
sector
uint8_t

LSM sector index (from seu_api_get_first_valid_sector()).

err_mode
uint8_t

SEU_API_FPGA_RAM_ERR_MODE_SBE (single-bit) or SEU_API_FPGA_RAM_ERR_MODE_DBE (double-bit, debug-only).

ram_id
uint8_t

Target RAM channel within the sector (0..31).

Returns

0 on success, -EINVAL on bad parameters, -EIO on SDM rejection.
